parameters.name: EffectiveBandwidthFilter
parameters.description: Filters the results by the actual bandwidth. Only positive integers are supported. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
A pagination token. It is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

- If **NextToken** is empty, no more results are returned.

- If NextToken is not empty, the value of **NextToken** is used for the next query.

parameters.name: TrafficQosPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the QoS policy.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the queue in the QoS policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue in the QoS policy.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueName
parameters.description:
The name of the queue in the QoS policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the inter-region connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the transit router.
